text.en:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 112

TAKAFUL ORDER, 2008 NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 1(1) In exercise of the power conferred by section 1 ( 1), the Minister of Finance, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints ] the 30th. day of September, 2008 as the date on which the Takaful Order, 2008 shall commence. Made this 27th. day of Zulkaedah, 1429 Hijriah corresponding to the 25th. day of November, 2008.

DATO PADUKA AWANG HAJI ALI BIN APONG Permanent Secretary, Minister of Finance, Brunei Darussalam. I Dicetak oleh AWANG MOHIDIN BIN HAJI DAUD, Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam. Harga B$5.00
